name: Brunei
official: Nation of Brunei, Abode of Peace

facts.religion: Sunni Islam about 80%, Buddhist and Christian minorities

snapshot: A small, oil-rich sultanate on Borneo ruled by Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah, one of the world's longest-reigning monarchs, under a strict Islamic legal code.
culture: Brunei follows a state ideology called Melayu Islam Beraja, Malay Islamic Monarchy. The golden-domed Omar Ali Saifuddien Mosque and the water village of Kampong Ayer, where thousands live in houses on stilts, are national symbols. Alcohol is banned for Muslims and public celebration of Christmas is restricted.
society: Oil and gas make up most exports and fund free healthcare, education and no personal income tax, giving Brunei one of the highest living standards in Asia. A sharia penal code phased in from 2014 includes severe punishments, though Brunei has a moratorium on the death penalty.
baseline: Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah has reigned since 1967 and also serves as prime minister, defence minister, finance minister and foreign minister. His son, Crown Prince Al-Muhtadee Billah, is senior minister and heir.

leaders.gov: The sultan also serves as prime minister
